mapper.sql: id, risk_id, delivery_id, risk_type, risk_level, factor_status, estimated_arrival_time, risk_score, evidence, first_detected_time, closed_time, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM delivery_risk_factor WHERE risk_id = #{riskId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY first_detected_time ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_risk_factor SET factor_status = 'closed', closed_time = NOW() WHERE risk_id = #{riskId} AND factor_status = 'active' AND is_deleted = 0
